Brook (2/2): (On having to make one or two choices with a strong bench strength?) Oh, it's definitely a good problem to have, I think. I said before the start of the series, we're building towards a squad that you feel like if someone does go down, someone can come in and fill that role exceptionally well. And we've seen that today with Coxy, Sonny, the way that he bowled, and then obviously Daws (Dawson) to pick up three wickets there as well. It feels like we're really building towards a very strong squad and I have full trust in anyone that can come in. (On their plans regarding the upcoming tour of Pakistan?) Everybody will be going home with that in the back of our minds. I think we'll still go away and train and get ready for a fairly long winter.
